title: 3.3.7 Lab: Front-of-Line Queue
description: Use push and shift to move people through a queue, first in first out. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a line array
steps.instructions: Create a variable called line and assign it an array containing at least two name strings.

steps.title: Add someone to the back
steps.instructions: Use .push() to add one more name onto the back of the line.

steps.title: Serve the first person
steps.instructions: Use .shift() to remove the first person from the line and store the returned value in a variable.

steps.title: Log who is served and the rest
steps.instructions: Use console.log to print who is being served, then console.log the remaining line array.

requirements.title: .push used on the line
requirements.description: Code calls .push( on an array, and the same array is later shifted. Help: 3.3.6 (Adding and Removing from the Front)

requirements.title: .shift result is used
requirements.description: The value .shift() hands back is stored and logged (or logged directly). Help: 3.3.6 (Adding and Removing from the Front)

requirements.title: console.log present
requirements.description: Code calls console.log. Help: 3.3.6 (Adding and Removing from the Front)
